scripture.verse: "As it is written, Behold I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and rock of offense: and whoever believes on Him shall not be ashamed."
"For of Him and through Him and to Him, are all things: to whom be glory forever. Amen."
"And he said unto them, Go ye into all the world, and preach the gospel to every creature. He that believeth and is baptized shall be saved; but he that believeth not shall be damned."

sermons.title: Sermon 574 | The Superlative Excellence Of The Holy Spirit

scripture.verse: "Nevertheless I tell you the truth. It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send Him unto you."

sermons.title: Sermon 575 | The Pierced One Pierces The Heart

scripture.verse: "And I will pour upon the house of David and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of Grace and of supplications: and they shall look upon Me whom they have pierced and they shall mourn for Him, as one mourns for his only son and shall be in bitterness for Him, as one that is in bitterness for his first-born."
"While I was musing the fire burned."
"Let us go forth therefore unto Him outside the camp, bearing His reproach."

sermons.title: Sermon 578 | A Bad Excuse Is Worse Than None

scripture.verse: "And they all with one consent began to make excuses."

sermons.title: Sermon 579 | God Pleading For Saints, And Saints Pleading For God

scripture.verse: "O Lord, You ha ve pleaded the causes of my soul; You have redeemed my life."
